alt: Merkel cell + Merkel disc - slowly-adapting mechanoreceptors in the stratum basale of the epidermis. Detect sustained light touch + texture. The disc is the nerve ending; the Merkel cell is the modified epithelial cell it contacts. (Blausen Medical CC BY 3.0)
